_meta.description: Kynver context-envelope contract fixture v1 — M3.5 multi-repo compatibility.
_meta.notes: Used by both Kynver-side and Hermes-side smoke tests. Changing this fixture is a breaking contract change requiring a version bump and matching adapter update. kynverCommit = merge SHA of Kynver PR #2130; kynverPrHeadCommit = head SHA at review time.

memories.content: Hermes Forge is the M3 dogfood adapter for Kynver context envelopes.
Kynver AgentOS/MARM is the authoritative context substrate for connected agents.

recentSessions.summary: Implemented M3 read-only Hermes context-envelope provider.
